lastCompletedStory.title: Dashboard + cam status render real per-story progress

nextStoryContext: US-002 extended DashboardData with lastActivity (ISO string from state file), extended StatusReport with storiesDone/storiesTotal/lastActivity, replaced the iter row in both Dashboard.tsx and runStatus with a stories done/total row, and updated the since row to use last_activity when present. The composeDashboard (non-Ink legacy) path was NOT changed (surgical changes). All state-file fields are guarded with typeof checks per the read-only-readers-never-throw pattern.

officialDocsValidated.summary: render(ReactElement) returns {lastFrame, unmount, frames, rerender, stdin, stdout}. lastFrame() returns the last rendered string. unmount() unmounts the component. Usage confirmed matches implementation.
